info.title: vcon-server
info.description: Stores vCons encrypted at rest and returns them to authorised readers. Every route needs a bearer key; errors are RFC 9457 problem documents.

post.description: Needs a key with the write scope.

409.description: Conflict: conflict, immutable, not-deleted, name-taken, holds-vcons or under-hold

post.summary: The MCP server (Model Context Protocol, streamable HTTP)
post.description: Takes one JSON-RPC message per request and answers it in one JSON body, with no session and no event stream; GET and DELETE answer 405. Needs any valid key; each tool needs the scope its area and hints give it. Every request is counted in the key's log as mcp. A request with an Origin header is refused.

200.description: The JSON-RPC answer; a refused tool call is a JSON-RPC error whose data is the problem document

400.description: Not one JSON-RPC message, or protocol headers that do not match it

403.description: The request carries an Origin header

406.description: The Accept header does not take application/json and text/event-stream

408.description: The body did not arrive in time: timeout

413.description: The body is over the size limit: too-large

500.description: The MCP server failed

503.description: The service cannot answer now: unavailable or audit-failed
